title: Shabbir Tera Sajda Sajdon Ki Inteha Hai
body:
Khoon-e-Hussain Say Hee (x2) Buniyad Laillah Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaye Baar Teer Uskay Hatho Say Ghirta Dekha (x2)
Khata Hai Khauf Dekho (x2) Asghar Say Hurmala Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghurbat Ki Sada Ran Main Daitay Hay Shah Baikas (x2)
Akbar Raha Na Asghar (x2) Aur Na Hee Bawafa Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Khud Apne Laal Pehjay Agoosh Main Ajaal Ki (x2)
Kitna Azeem Karbal (x2) Maa’ou Ka Honsla Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas Tera Sar Nay Dekha Hai Kaisay Manzaar (x2)
Ik Naizay Saar Buland Hai (x2) Ik Naizay Pay Rida Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Dastar-e-Istarha Say Akbar Ko Shah Nay Bandhi (x2)
Sab Bibiyon Nay Khaimay (x2) Inna Illah Para Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Laash Ko Main Qasim Dhondo Kaha Kaha Paar (x2)
Tanha Hussain Ran Main (x2) Daitay Rahi Sada Hai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhayi Ka Pyaar Dekha Jag Say Anokha Shahid (x2)
Honto Pay Naam Zainab (x2) Khanjar Talay Gala Hai.
